title: Relativistic Algebra over Finite Fields
content: We present a formal reconstruction of number systems over a finite field \( \mathbb{F}_p \), based on the principle of relational finitude. Rather than assuming actual infinity, we define arithmetic and algebra as observer-dependent constructs grounded in finite field symmetries. The conventional number classes–integers, rationals, reals, and complex numbers–are reinterpreted as pseudo-numbers, expressed relationally with respect to a chosen reference frame. We define explicit mappings for each number class, preserving their algebraic and computational properties while eliminating ontological dependence on infinite structures. This approach establishes a finite, coherent foundation for mathematics and physics in ontologically finite informational systems.
